headline: Genki’s new customizable controller has a big screen and adjustable buttons
summary: Genki launched its first self-designed customizable controller, the Manta. It features an unorthodox design with a large 2.9-inch LCD screen. The controller also boasts adjustable thumbsticks and buttons.

headline: Google Discover is getting an AI chatbot-tuned feed
summary: Google Discover will soon offer an AI-chatbot-tuned feed. Users can customize their feed by describing desired content. The AI will learn preferences for future visits.

headline: Riot is ending development on its League of Legends fighting game
summary: Riot Games is ceasing development on its free-to-play fighting game, 2XKO. Active development concludes at the end of 2026. The decision stems from insufficient player retention for sustainability.

headline: The Genesis GV90 blows the bloody doors off what’s possible in EV design
summary: Genesis revealed the GV90, its first full-size, three-row electric SUV for the US. It features wild designs, including unique coach-style doors. The GV90 aims to push boundaries in EV design.

headline: Netflix Reveals New Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Trailer and Images at Anime NYC
summary: Netflix unveiled a new trailer and images for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. The reveal happened at Anime NYC. It promises high-octane action and tragic elements.

headline: Netflix Confirms Blue Eye Samurai Will End With Third and Final Season
summary: Netflix announced that Blue Eye Samurai will conclude. The series will end with its third season. This marks the official final season for the show.

headline: Netflix Reveals Packed Anime Slate: Full Announcement Rundown, Trailers, and Images
summary: Netflix showcased a massive slate of upcoming anime projects at Anime NYC. The presentation included exclusive trailers and images. Highlights featured Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 and Blue Eye Samurai.

headline: Double Your PlayStation 5 Storage With This 1TB PCIe M.2 SSD for Just $136.39 Shipped
summary: A 1TB PCIe M.2 SSD is available for just $136.39, including shipping. This deal allows PlayStation 5 owners to double their console's storage. It's described as a "near-essential PS5 upgrade."

headline: El Niño weather system set to be 'strongest in living memory', warns Met Office
summary: The Met Office warns the current El Niño system will be the "strongest in living memory." Scientists call it an "unprecedented event." This makes 2027 likely the world's hottest year on record.

headline: Will Harry's return heal rift with his brother? Don't hold your breath
summary: Prince William remains unwilling to forgive Prince Harry. The deep hurt from their rift persists. Harry's return is unlikely to mend the fraternal divide.

headline: Meghan could return to acting once back in UK
summary: Reports suggest Meghan Markle has been offered a UK acting role. Sources close to the Sussexes have not denied these claims. A return to acting for Meghan is possible upon her return to the UK.

headline: French becoming more effective in stopping small boat crossings, UK says
summary: The UK Home Office reports France is more effective at stopping small boat crossings. New tactics this summer led to hundreds of interceptions. This indicates improved collaboration and success.
